hooks.command: input=$(cat); if command -v prufgate >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' "$input" | prufgate hook claude pre-tool; rc=$?; elif python3 -c 'import prufgate.cli' >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' "$input" | python3 -m prufgate.cli hook claude pre-tool; rc=$?; elif python -c 'import prufgate.cli' >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' "$input" | python -m prufgate.cli hook claude pre-tool; rc=$?; else echo 'prufgate: not installed (no prufgate on PATH, no engine module for python3 or python); shell commands and file edits are blocked until it is' >&2; rc=3; fi; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && exit 0; [ "$rc" -eq 2 ] || echo "prufgate: hook claude pre-tool could not run (exit $rc)" >&2; exit 2

input=$(cat); case "$input" in *'"stop_hook_active": true'*|*'"stop_hook_active":true'*) active=1;; *) active=0;; esac; if command -v prufgate >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' "$input" | prufgate hook claude stop; rc=$?; elif python3 -c 'import prufgate.cli' >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' "$input" | python3 -m prufgate.cli hook claude stop; rc=$?; elif python -c 'import prufgate.cli' >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' "$input" | python -m prufgate.cli hook claude stop; rc=$?; else echo 'prufgate: not installed (no prufgate on PATH, no engine module for python3 or python); this work is not checked until it is' >&2; rc=3; fi; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && exit 0; [ "$rc" -eq 2 ] || echo "prufgate: hook claude stop could not run (exit $rc)" >&2; [ "$active" -eq 1 ] && exit 0; exit 2
